title: Cannot add a min value to the range slider without a max
body: When I add only a min value an error is returned saying range is not numeric

comments.body: I just tried in our dev app (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js#development-workflow) and it worked well. Could you create a small jsFiddle reproducing the issue? Thanks
